name: oh-my-agent-mod
description: oh-my-agent (/oma): one router session that never builds. It writes tickets with you, hands each to a worker in its own git worktree, has a reviewer check it, merges it with `oma merge`, reviews the whole run, sends blind first-time visitors through the app at the end and fixes small bugs, coming to you only for decisions. Sets each project up on first /oma and works alongside oh-my-context (omc).
